[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 08:55  
[USER] User is thinking of baking chicken wings for dinner.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for achieving crispy chicken wings, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Dry brine: Pat wings dry, sprinkle with salt, refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with convection setting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Mix 1-2 tablespoons of baking powder with 1 tablespoon of salt and sprinkle over wings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Drizzle oil and add seasonings (e.g., garlic powder, paprika, buffalo sauce).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Arrange wings in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with foil or parchment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Bake for 30-35 minutes, then broil for 5-7 minutes until crispy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Increase oven temperature to 450°F (230°C) for the last 10-15 minutes for extra crispiness.  
[USER] User plans to try the dry brine method and baking powder trick for the chicken wings.  
[USER] User is experimenting with different types of flour for baking.  
[USER] User has not tried roasting vegetables with convection yet.  
[USER] User used the oven's convection setting for the first time last Thursday to bake cookies, which turned out amazing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended roasted vegetables to pair with chicken wings, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Broccoli: Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, roast at 425°F for 15-20 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Carrots: Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, honey, roast at 425°F for 20-25 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Brussels Sprouts: Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, roast at 425°F for 20-25 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Cauliflower: Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, paprika, roast at 425°F for 20-25 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Asparagus: Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, lemon juice, roast at 425°F for 12-15 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for convection roasting vegetables, including spreading them out, tossing with oil
